input.overview: Ready...Aim...Fire! is a color-set prize ladder. Complete all spot targets of one color, then hit that color's flashing pop bumper to win the next animal prize. Each prize raises the end-of-ball bonus multiplier; the sequence is Bear, Giraffe, Elephant, then Tiger.
input.simpleOverview: Finish every spot target in one color, then hit that color's flashing pop bumper to win a prize. Prizes raise Bonus X in order from Bear to Giraffe to Elephant to Tiger.
input.summary: Work one visible color set at a time, collect it at the matching flashing pop, and use the resulting prize ladder to grow Bonus X.

quickInfo.name: Qualify Prize
quickInfo.summary: Complete every spot target of one color.

quickInfo.name: Win Prize
quickInfo.summary: Hit that color's flashing pop bumper.

quickInfo.name: Raise Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: Each won prize adds one multiplier step.

steps.text: Choose a color with few remaining spot targets and finish that set.
Hit the matching flashing pop bumper to win the next animal prize.
Repeat the color-set and pop-bumper cycle to raise the bonus multiplier.
After three prizes, use only the outlane award that is visibly lit; after four, the top rollover can light for Special.
Win Bear, then Giraffe, Elephant, and Tiger through four color completions.
Use each prize to raise Bonus X.
After the fourth prize, score the lit top rollover for Special or its configured substitute.

machineSetup: Test every colored spot target, all four pop bumpers and flashing lamps, prize lamps, bonus ladder, top rollover, and both outlane lamps.
Confirm three- or five-ball play and how Extra Ball and Special are converted.

playfieldReferences.description: Targets grouped by the four pop-bumper colors.

playfieldReferences.label: Prize-collect pop bumper
playfieldReferences.description: Matching pop that awards a prize after its color set is complete.

playfieldReferences.label: Top Special rollover
playfieldReferences.description: Top lane lit for Special after the fourth prize.

cautions.issue: The inspected English card says one outlane lights for Extra Ball after three prizes, while the French card says both outlanes.
cautions.response: Follow the lamps on the exact game and do not assume both sides are active.
